pinyin: Hěn róngxìng rènshi nín, Wáng zǒng.
en: It is an honour to meet you, Mr Wang.

zh: 这是我的名片，请多多指教。
pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ de míngpiàn, qǐng duōduō zhǐjiào.
en: Here is my card; I look forward to your guidance.

zh: 我们是一家专注于跨境投资的私募股权基金。
pinyin: Wǒmen shì yì jiā zhuānzhù yú kuàjìng tóuzī de sīmù gǔquán jījīn.
en: We are a private equity fund focused on cross-border investment.
note: |Wǒmen shì yī jiā zhuānzhù yú kuàjìng tóuzī de sīmù gǔquán jījīn.||Tone sandhi of 一 should not be written; use dictionary tone yī.

zh: 我们正在募集第三期美元基金，目标规模五亿美元。
pinyin: Wǒmen zhèngzài mùjí dì-sān qī měiyuán jījīn, mùbiāo guīmó wǔ yì měiyuán.
en: We are raising our third USD fund, targeting 500 million dollars.

zh: 管理费百分之二，业绩报酬百分之二十，门槛收益率百分之八。
pinyin: Guǎnlǐfèi bǎi fēn zhī èr, yèjì bàochou bǎi fēn zhī èrshí, ménkǎn shōuyìlǜ bǎi fēn zhī bā.
en: Two percent management fee, twenty percent carry, eight percent hurdle.

zh: 您有兴趣做我们的基石投资者吗？
pinyin: Nín yǒu xìngqù zuò wǒmen de jīshí tóuzīzhě ma?
en: Would you be interested in anchoring the fund?

zh: 这个项目我们很感兴趣，想进一步了解。
pinyin: Zhè ge xiàngmù wǒmen hěn gǎn xìngqù, xiǎng jìnyíbù liǎojiě.
en: We are very interested in this deal and would like to learn more.
note: |Zhège xiàngmù wǒmen hěn gǎn xìngqù, xiǎng jìnyībù liǎojiě.||一 keeps its dictionary tone: jìnyībù, not jìnyíbù.

zh: 这一轮谁领投？我们可以考虑跟投。
pinyin: Zhè yì lún shéi lǐngtóu? Wǒmen kěyǐ kǎolǜ gēntóu.
en: Who is leading this round? We could consider following.
note: |Zhè yī lún shéi lǐngtóu? Wǒmen kěyǐ kǎolǜ gēntóu.||Tone sandhi is not written: 一 should be yī.

zh: 请先签保密协议，然后我们发商业计划书。
pinyin: Qǐng xiān qiān bǎomì xiéyì, ránhòu wǒmen fā shāngyè jìhuàshū.
en: Please sign the NDA first, then we will send the business plan.

note: |yī piào fǒujuéquán||一 keeps its dictionary tone yī; sandhi is not written.

zh: 我们的报价是投前估值两亿美元，投资三千万美元。
pinyin: Wǒmen de bàojià shì tóuqián gūzhí liǎng yì měiyuán, tóuzī sānqiān wàn měiyuán.
en: Our offer is a 200 million pre-money valuation, investing 30 million.
note: ||Our offer is a pre-money valuation of 200 million US dollars, with an investment of 30 million US dollars.|English omitted the currency (美元) stated in the Chinese.

zh: 一倍不参与分配的优先清算权是我们的底线。
pinyin: Yí bèi bù cānyù fēnpèi de yōuxiān qīngsuànquán shì wǒmen de dǐxiàn.
en: A one-times non-participating liquidation preference is our bottom line.
note: |Yī bèi bù cānyù fēnpèi de yōuxiān qīngsuànquán shì wǒmen de dǐxiàn.||一 should keep dictionary tone yī without written sandhi.

zh: 估值可以谈，但是董事会席位不能少。
pinyin: Gūzhí kěyǐ tán, dànshì dǒngshìhuì xíwèi bù néng shǎo.
en: Valuation is negotiable, but the board seat is not.

zh: 请把最近三年的审计报告放进数据室。
pinyin: Qǐng bǎ zuìjìn sān nián de shěnjì bàogào fàng jìn shùjùshì.
en: Please put the last three years of audit reports in the data room.
note: |Qǐng bǎ zuìjìn sān nián de shěnjì bàogào fàngjìn shùjùshì.||放进 is one word in pinyin.

zh: 这笔关联交易是怎么定价的？
pinyin: Zhè bǐ guānlián jiāoyì shì zěnme dìngjià de?
en: How was this related-party transaction priced?

zh: 毛利率为什么去年下降了五个百分点？
pinyin: Máolìlǜ wèi shénme qùnián xiàjiàng le wǔ ge bǎifēndiǎn?
en: Why did gross margin fall five percentage points last year?
note: 毛利率去年为什么下降了五个百分点？|Máolìlǜ qùnián wèishénme xiàjiàngle wǔ ge bǎifēndiǎn?||Time word normally precedes 为什么; pinyin joins 为什么 and 下降了.
|dáchéng yīzhì||一 keeps its dictionary tone (sandhi not written).
|yuánzé shàng||上 here is full fourth tone.

zh: 我们原则上同意，细节还需要再讨论。
pinyin: Wǒmen yuánzé shang tóngyì, xìjié hái xūyào zài tǎolùn.
en: We agree in principle; the details need more discussion.
note: |Wǒmen yuánzé shàng tóngyì, xìjié hái xūyào zài tǎolùn.||上 should be shàng.

zh: 这一点我们可以让步，但估值上希望您也灵活一些。
pinyin: Zhè yì diǎn wǒmen kěyǐ ràngbù, dàn gūzhí shang xīwàng nín yě línghuó yìxiē.
en: We can concede this point, but we hope you can be flexible on valuation too.
note: |Zhè yī diǎn wǒmen kěyǐ ràngbù, dàn gūzhí shàng xīwàng nín yě línghuó yīxiē.||一 keeps dictionary tone and 上 is shàng.

zh: 我们内部再讨论一下，明天给您答复。
pinyin: Wǒmen nèibù zài tǎolùn yíxià, míngtiān gěi nín dáfù.
en: We will discuss internally and reply tomorrow.
note: |Wǒmen nèibù zài tǎolùn yīxià, míngtiān gěi nín dáfù.||一 sandhi should not be written.

zh: 这已经是我们最后的报价了。
pinyin: Zhè yǐjīng shì wǒmen zuìhòu de bàojià le.
en: This is already our final offer.

zh: 我看我们各让一步，折中一下怎么样？
pinyin: Wǒ kàn wǒmen gè ràng yí bù, zhézhōng yíxià zěnmeyàng?
en: How about we each give a little and split the difference?
note: |Wǒ kàn wǒmen gè ràng yī bù, zhézhōng yīxià zěnmeyàng?||一 keeps dictionary tone in both places.

en: to convert foreign currency into RMB

zh: 所有交割条件满足后三个工作日内付款。
pinyin: Suǒyǒu jiāogē tiáojiàn mǎnzú hòu sān ge gōngzuòrì nèi fùkuǎn.
en: Payment within three business days after all conditions precedent are satisfied.
note: 所有交割条件满足后，三个工作日内付款。|Suǒyǒu jiāogē tiáojiàn mǎnzú hòu, sān ge gōngzuòrì nèi fùkuǎn.||A comma after the long adverbial clause is needed for readability.

zh: 资金先打到托管账户，工商变更完成后再释放。
pinyin: Zījīn xiān dǎ dào tuōguǎn zhànghù, gōngshāng biàngēng wánchéng hòu zài shìfàng.
en: Funds go to escrow first and are released after the registry update is complete.

zh: 境外直接投资备案大概需要多长时间？
pinyin: Jìngwài zhíjiē tóuzī bèi’àn dàgài xūyào duō cháng shíjiān?
en: Roughly how long will the ODI filing take?

zh: 我们按签约日的汇率结算。
pinyin: Wǒmen àn qiānyuē rì de huìlǜ jiésuàn.
en: We settle at the exchange rate on the signing date.

zh: 钱到账了，交割完成，合作愉快！
pinyin: Qián dàozhàng le, jiāogē wánchéng, hézuò yúkuài!
en: The funds have arrived, closing is complete, here’s to working together!
to stamp with the company seal

zh: 协议适用香港法律，争议提交香港国际仲裁中心仲裁。
pinyin: Xiéyì shìyòng Xiānggǎng fǎlǜ, zhēngyì tíjiāo Xiānggǎng Guójì Zhòngcái Zhōngxīn zhòngcái.
en: The agreement is governed by Hong Kong law; disputes go to HKIAC arbitration.

zh: 请贵方律师尽快回复我们的修改意见。
pinyin: Qǐng guìfāng lǜshī jǐnkuài huífù wǒmen de xiūgǎi yìjiàn.
en: Please have your counsel respond to our mark-up as soon as possible.

zh: 合同一式两份，双方签字盖章后生效。
pinyin: Hétong yí shì liǎng fèn, shuāngfāng qiānzì gàizhāng hòu shēngxiào.
en: Two originals; effective once both sides sign and chop.
note: |Hétong yīshì liǎng fèn, shuāngfāng qiānzì gàizhāng hòu shēngxiào.||一 should keep its dictionary tone yī (sandhi not written) and 一式 is one word.

en: to reduce a holding / sell down

zh: 我们计划三到五年内通过上市或并购退出。
pinyin: Wǒmen jìhuà sān dào wǔ nián nèi tōngguò shàngshì huò bìnggòu tuìchū.
en: We plan to exit within three to five years via IPO or M&A.

zh: 上一期基金的内部收益率是百分之二十五，回报倍数三倍。
pinyin: Shàng yì qī jījīn de nèibù shōuyìlǜ shì bǎi fēn zhī èrshíwǔ, huíbào bèishù sān bèi.
en: The previous fund’s IRR was 25 percent with a 3x multiple.
note: |Shàng yī qī jījīn de nèibù shōuyìlǜ shì bǎi fēn zhī èrshíwǔ, huíbào bèishù sān bèi.||一 keeps its dictionary tone yī since tone sandhi is not written.

zh: 我敬您一杯，感谢您的信任和支持。
pinyin: Wǒ jìng nín yì bēi, gǎnxiè nín de xìnrèn hé zhīchí.
en: A toast to you, with thanks for your trust and support.
note: |Wǒ jìng nín yī bēi, gǎnxiè nín de xìnrèn hé zhīchí.||一 keeps its dictionary tone yī; sandhi not written.

en: To a happy partnership; let’s stay in close touch!

zh: 今天我做东，大家别客气。
pinyin: Jīntiān wǒ zuòdōng, dàjiā bié kèqi.
en: Tonight is on me, everyone; please don’t stand on ceremony.
note: ||Today it's on me, everyone; please don't stand on ceremony.|今天 means today, not tonight.

pinyin: Xiān zuò péngyou, zài zuò shēngyi.

note: |bǎifēnzhī||Pinyin is written as a single unit, not spaced syllables.

zh: 三千万美元，大约两亿一千万人民币。
pinyin: Sānqiān wàn měiyuán, dàyuē liǎng yì yìqiān wàn rénmínbì.
en: Thirty million dollars, roughly 210 million RMB.
note: |Sānqiān wàn měiyuán, dàyuē liǎng yì yīqiān wàn rénmínbì.||一 keeps its dictionary tone yī in pinyin (no written sandhi).

zh: 估值打八折，我们就可以马上签。
pinyin: Gūzhí dǎ bā zhé, wǒmen jiù kěyǐ mǎshàng qiān.
en: A 20 percent discount on valuation and we can sign immediately.
to liaise / connect with a counterpart

zh: 王总您好，附件是今天的会议纪要，请您确认。
pinyin: Wáng zǒng nín hǎo, fùjiàn shì jīntiān de huìyì jìyào, qǐng nín quèrèn.
en: Hello Mr Wang, attached are today’s minutes, please confirm.

zh: 方便的话，我们下周三北京时间上午十点视频会议？
pinyin: Fāngbiàn de huà, wǒmen xià zhōusān Běijīng shíjiān shàngwǔ shí diǎn shìpín huìyì?
en: If convenient, a video call next Wednesday at 10 a.m. Beijing time?
note: 方便的话，我们下周三北京时间上午十点开个视频会议？|Fāngbiàn de huà, wǒmen xià zhōusān Běijīng shíjiān shàngwǔ shí diǎn kāi ge shìpín huìyì?||The sentence needs a verb; 开个视频会议 is the natural phrasing.

zh: 麻烦您加一下我的微信，方便后续对接。
pinyin: Máfan nín jiā yíxià wǒ de Wēixìn, fāngbiàn hòuxù duìjiē.
en: Please add my WeChat so we can coordinate going forward.
note: |Máfan nín jiā yīxià wǒ de Wēixìn, fāngbiàn hòuxù duìjiē.||一 should keep dictionary tone yī in pinyin.

zh: 我们尽快推进，争取月底前完成交割。
pinyin: Wǒmen jǐnkuài tuījìn, zhēngqǔ yuèdǐ qián wánchéng jiāogē.
en: We will push ahead quickly and aim to close before month-end.

zh: 李总，我们的报价是投前估值两亿美元，投资三千万。
pinyin: Lǐ zǒng, wǒmen de bàojià shì tóuqián gūzhí liǎng yì měiyuán, tóuzī sānqiān wàn.
en: Mr Li, our offer is 200 million pre-money, investing 30 million.

zh: 坦白说，我们期望的估值是两亿五千万。
pinyin: Tǎnbái shuō, wǒmen qīwàng de gūzhí shì liǎng yì wǔqiān wàn.

zh: 估值我们可以再谈，但一倍优先清算权和一个董事会席位是底线。
pinyin: Gūzhí wǒmen kěyǐ zài tán, dàn yí bèi yōuxiān qīngsuànquán hé yí ge dǒngshìhuì xíwèi shì dǐxiàn.
en: Valuation is open, but a 1x liquidation preference and one board seat are our bottom line.
note: |Gūzhí wǒmen kěyǐ zài tán, dàn yī bèi yōuxiān qīngsuànquán hé yī ge dǒngshìhuì xíwèi shì dǐxiàn.||Tone sandhi of 一 should not be written; use yī.

zh: 席位没问题。清算权我们希望是不参与分配的。
pinyin: Xíwèi méi wèntí. Qīngsuànquán wǒmen xīwàng shì bù cānyù fēnpèi de.
en: The seat is fine. On the preference we want non-participating.

zh: 可以。那估值我们折中，两亿两千五百万，怎么样？
pinyin: Kěyǐ. Nà gūzhí wǒmen zhézhōng, liǎng yì liǎngqiān wǔbǎi wàn, zěnmeyàng?
en: Agreed. Then let’s split the difference on valuation: 225 million?

zh: 我们内部讨论一下，明天给您答复。
pinyin: Wǒmen nèibù tǎolùn yíxià, míngtiān gěi nín dáfù.
en: We will discuss internally and reply tomorrow.
note: |Wǒmen nèibù tǎolùn yīxià, míngtiān gěi nín dáfù.||一 keeps dictionary tone: yīxià.

zh: 交割条件还剩两项：境外直接投资备案和工商变更。
pinyin: Jiāogē tiáojiàn hái shèng liǎng xiàng: jìngwài zhíjiē tóuzī bèi’àn hé gōngshāng biàngēng.
en: Two conditions precedent remain: the ODI filing and the registry update.

zh: 备案下周能拿到，工商变更大概需要十个工作日。
pinyin: Bèi’àn xià zhōu néng nádào, gōngshāng biàngēng dàgài xūyào shí ge gōngzuòrì.
en: The filing comes next week; the registry update needs about ten business days.

zh: 那我们先把资金打到托管账户，变更完成后释放。
pinyin: Nà wǒmen xiān bǎ zījīn dǎ dào tuōguǎn zhànghù, biàngēng wánchéng hòu shìfàng.
en: Then we will wire the funds to escrow and release them once the update is done.

zh: 同意。汇率按签约日计算，对吧？
pinyin: Tóngyì. Huìlǜ àn qiānyuē rì jìsuàn, duì ba?
en: Agreed. The exchange rate is fixed at the signing date, correct?

zh: 对。我今天把时间表发给大家，请确认。
pinyin: Duì. Wǒ jīntiān bǎ shíjiānbiǎo fā gěi dàjiā, qǐng quèrèn.
en: Correct. I will send the timeline today; please confirm.

zh: 张总，感谢您抽时间。我们正在募集第三期美元基金，目标五亿。
pinyin: Zhāng zǒng, gǎnxiè nín chōu shíjiān. Wǒmen zhèngzài mùjí dì-sān qī měiyuán jījīn, mùbiāo wǔ yì.
en: Mr Zhang, thank you for your time. We are raising our third USD fund, targeting 500 million.

pinyin: Qián liǎng qī de yèjì zěnmeyàng?
en: How did the first two funds perform?

zh: 一期已经全部退出，内部收益率百分之二十八，回报倍数三点二倍。
pinyin: Yī qī yǐjīng quánbù tuìchū, nèibù shōuyìlǜ bǎi fēn zhī èrshíbā, huíbào bèishù sān diǎn èr bèi.
en: Fund I is fully exited: 28 percent IRR, 3.2x.

zh: 二和二十，门槛收益率百分之八。基石投资者可以享受费用优惠。
pinyin: Èr hé èrshí, ménkǎn shōuyìlǜ bǎi fēn zhī bā. Jīshí tóuzīzhě kěyǐ xiǎngshòu fèiyòng yōuhuì.
en: Two and twenty, eight percent hurdle. Anchor investors get a fee discount.

zh: 有意思。把材料发我，我们投委会下个月讨论。
pinyin: Yǒu yìsi. Bǎ cáiliào fā wǒ, wǒmen tóuwěihuì xià ge yuè tǎolùn.
en: Interesting. Send me the materials; our IC will discuss next month.

zh: 您好，我是王磊，很高兴认识您。您是哪家基金的？
pinyin: Nín hǎo, wǒ shì Wáng Lěi, hěn gāoxìng rènshi nín. Nín shì nǎ jiā jījīn de?
en: Hello, I am Wang Lei, pleased to meet you. Which fund are you with?

zh: 张总让我先听听你们基金的情况。你们这期规模多大，主要投什么赛道？
pinyin: Zhāng zǒng ràng wǒ xiān tīngting nǐmen jījīn de qíngkuàng. Nǐmen zhè qī guīmó duō dà, zhǔyào tóu shénme sàidào?
en: Mr Zhang asked me to hear about your fund first. How big is this vintage, and which sectors do you back?

zh: 你们的条款清单我看了。估值太低了，而且我不太能接受一票否决权。
pinyin: Nǐmen de tiáokuǎn qīngdān wǒ kàn le. Gūzhí tài dī le, érqiě wǒ bú tài néng jiēshòu yí piào fǒujuéquán.
en: I have read your term sheet. The valuation is too low, and I cannot really accept a veto right.
note: |Nǐmen de tiáokuǎn qīngdān wǒ kàn le. Gūzhí tài dī le, érqiě wǒ bù tài néng jiēshòu yī piào fǒujuéquán.||Tone sandhi should not be written: 不 and 一 keep dictionary tones.

zh: 数据室已经开放了。你们财务尽调主要想了解哪些方面？
pinyin: Shùjùshì yǐjīng kāifàng le. Nǐmen cáiwù jìndiào zhǔyào xiǎng liǎojiě nǎxiē fāngmiàn?
en: The data room is open. Which areas does your financial diligence focus on?

zh: 我们过一下交割清单吧。目前还有哪些条件没有满足？
pinyin: Wǒmen guò yíxià jiāogē qīngdān ba. Mùqián hái yǒu nǎxiē tiáojiàn méiyǒu mǎnzú?
en: Let’s go through the closing checklist. Which conditions are still outstanding?
note: |Wǒmen guò yīxià jiāogē qīngdān ba. Mùqián hái yǒu nǎxiē tiáojiàn méiyǒu mǎnzú?||一 keeps its dictionary tone in pinyin (yīxià).

zh: 来来来，签约成功，我先敬你一杯！
pinyin: Lái lái lái, qiānyuē chénggōng, wǒ xiān jìng nǐ yì bēi!
en: Come, come — the signing is done, let me toast you first!
note: |Lái lái lái, qiānyuē chénggōng, wǒ xiān jìng nǐ yī bēi!||一 should be written yī, not sandhi yì.
